card.name: Lambada
card.tagline: Para-origin couples dance, a 1989 global sensation.
card.profile: Lambada is a partner dance (and music genre) originating in Para, northern Brazil, fusing carimbo with Caribbean and other rhythms. Danced in close embrace with pronounced hip movement and arched turns, often with short skirts and circular motion, it became a worldwide craze in 1989 via Kaoma's single 'Lambada' (English Wikipedia).
card.insight: Kaoma's 'Lambada' (1989) sold millions worldwide and topped charts in over 15 countries; per English Wikipedia it was the most successful European single in the history of CBS Records. Lambada is the direct parent of Brazilian Zouk.
